run_canvas_list_courses: run the canvas API CLI to list enrolled courses with optional per-page and enrollment-state filters
run_canvas_list_assignments: run the canvas API CLI to list assignments for a given course ID with per-page and order-by options
test_canvas_paginated_get: test the paginated GET helper that follows Canvas Link headers to fetch all pages up to a max item limit
review_canvas_check_config: review the config validation function that checks for required CANVAS_API_TOKEN and CANVAS_BASE_URL environment variables
summarize_canvas_headers: summarize the headers helper that constructs the Bearer token authorization header for Canvas API requests
